title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 7: a holy people chosen by Yahweh, the seven nations and the hornet.

questions.text: How many nations greater and mightier than Israel are named in Deuteronomy 7:1?
questions.explanation: Moses lists the Hittite, Girgashite, Amorite, Canaanite, Perizzite, Hivite and Jebusite: seven nations greater and mightier than Israel.

answers.text: Seven
Five
Twelve
Three

questions.text: Why were the Israelites not to make marriages with these nations?
questions.explanation: Such marriages would turn their sons away from following Yahweh to serve other gods, and Yahweh's anger would be kindled against them.

answers.text: The nations spoke another language
Their land would have to be divided
It would turn their sons away to serve other gods
The nations had no cattle to give

questions.text: What were they to do with the Asherah poles of these nations?
questions.explanation: They were to break down their altars, dash their pillars in pieces, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their engraved images.

answers.text: Carry them to the tabernacle
Cut them down
Leave them standing as a warning
Sell them to traders

questions.explanation: Israel is a holy people to Yahweh, chosen to be a people for his own possession above all peoples on the earth.

answers.text: A kingdom of kings and princes
A nation of giants and warriors
A people with no land of their own
A holy people to Yahweh their God

questions.text: What does Deuteronomy 7:7 say about Israel's number when Yahweh chose them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh did not choose them because they were more in number than any people, for they were the fewest of all peoples.

answers.text: They were the largest of all nations
They were as many as Egypt
They were the fewest of all peoples
They were as many as the nations around them

questions.text: To how many generations does the faithful God keep covenant with those who love him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh is the faithful God who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations.

answers.text: Three generations
Ten generations
Forty generations
A thousand generations

questions.text: What will Yahweh do with the evil diseases of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt on Israel, but will lay them on all those who hate them.

answers.text: Lay them on those who hate Israel, not on Israel
Send them on Israel if they complain
Keep them only in the land of Egypt
Heal them with water from the rock

questions.text: What will Yahweh send among the nations until those who hide themselves perish?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will send the hornet among them, until those who are left and hide themselves perish.

answers.text: Locusts
The hornet
Great hail
Frogs

questions.text: Why would Yahweh cast out the nations little by little?
questions.explanation: They could not consume them at once, lest the animals of the field increase on them.

answers.text: So that Israel could first learn the language of the land
Because Israel had too few weapons and too few men
So that the nations would have time to leave in peace
So that the animals of the field would not increase on them

questions.text: What were they not to covet from the engraved images of the nations' gods?
questions.explanation: They were to burn the images and not covet or take the silver or the gold on them, lest they be snared in it.

answers.text: The wood they were carved from
The silver or the gold on them
The clothes put on them
The incense burned before them
